newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk shares dive 1.99 pct on political concerns.
newsitem.headline: Turk shares dive 1.99 pct on political concerns.

text.p: Istanbul shares posted losses in in thin trade on Friday morning as the market was once again beset by concern over the fate of the Islamist-led coalition government, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 ended at 1,430, down 29 points, or 1.99 percent from Thursday when it shed 1.29 percent. Morning volume plunged to 3.65 trillion lira from 8.48 trillion on Thursday.
